parameters.jsCode: return $('Eligibility Filter').all().map(i => ({ json: { customer_id: i.json.customer_id, email_sequence: 'INITIAL' } }));

parameters.content:
WF1 - Find Eligible Customers

After import:
1. Every Google Sheets node: pick your service-account credential.
2. 'Get Settings' node: choose workflow 'WF0 - Get Settings'.
3. 'Call WF2 - Send Email' node: choose 'WF2 - Send Campaign Email'.
4. Test with 'Manual Run' (Execute workflow) before activating.
5. Activate only when you want the daily 09:00 run.
